bio_1: The operational architect behind Babycakes' explosive growth. Tess applies the rigor she learned at Chanel to the bakery's backend — transforming a backyard kitchen into a centralized operation capable of seven-figure monthly revenue.
bio_2: She leads expansion into prime locations like One Bangkok, Emsphere, and Central Chidlom, and manages the logistical complexity of 12+ distribution points across Bangkok.
